new_findings.anchor: Chapter 12 (ch12_how_much_brain.md) capacity table rows Scaling 6.5M / 10M point / 30M point: '| Scaling | **6,500,352** (6.5M) | 0.897 | **0.000** |'
new_findings.observed: Three of four rows print in-distribution pass@1 (0.897/0.773/0.897) with NO test-set denominator at point of use — only the baseline row carries one (0.9167, n=60). Source manifests carry none either: stage4_composition{,_6p5m,_10m}.json in_distribution entries hold only {label,syntax_rate,executable_rate,pass_at_1} — no n, no successes, no denominator; config carries only comp_per_op=40. So 0.896666... is consistent with 269/300, 538/600 or 1076/1200 alike: the denominator is UNDERDETERMINED, not merely unstated. Appendix C discusses denominators for other evaluations but never gives one for the three size points.
new_findings.root_cause: instrument/manifest schema drift: the Stage-4 size-sweep runner wrote bare rates, while the corrected-experiment runner (data_scaling_corrected_seed*.json) writes test_set.n, per-op counts and assertions.test_denominator_exact. Any A/B across sizes holds the denominator constant only by assumption; differing training budgets (1000 vs 800 steps) ARE disclosed, differing evaluation denominators are NOT.
new_findings.blast_radius: 3 table cells in the body + the same three numbers restated in the Appendix C size-sweep discussion and the capability-map summary table; the load-bearing composition 0.000 is unaffected. No number changes, only its auditability.
new_findings.correction: Add (n=<test size>) to the three rows of Table 12.1 and the matching Appendix C sentences, and record test_set.n/successes/denominator in the three stage4_composition* manifests (mirror data_scaling_corrected schema) so the cells are re-derivable from the artifact.
new_findings.acceptance: for each stage4_composition{,_6p5m,_10m}.json the manifest carries in_distribution.MODEL.denominator and successes with successes/denominator == pass_at_1, and the Chapter 12 table row prints that denominator at point of use
